sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed. The national payment network is down, so payments fail at the clearing step and 114 items are waiting in the clearing queue.
sbar.background: The network, run by an outside organisation, stopped answering, and 100% of requests now fail against a baseline of 0%, with p95 latency of 2030 ms. Every clearing send to it times out, and the clearing log shows 'network_send_failed msg=payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=94'.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage on the network (confidence 0.93), and clearing itself is healthy. Item 94 is waiting only because of the timeout and is not malformed. No allowed action could fix the network, so the incident commander itself escalated to the network operator.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the national payment network operator until their service is restored, then confirm clearing drains its 114-item backlog. Do not quarantine item 94, because it is not a poison item. Operations should review the 114 posted but uncleared payments for settlement delays.
